_readme: Fonts listed here appear for everyone under 'Shared (website)' in the label tool's font menus. Put the font file (.ttf, .otf or .woff — not .woff2) in site/assets/fonts/shared/ and add an entry: { "id": "better-me", "name": "Better Me", "regular": "assets/fonts/shared/BetterMe-Regular.ttf", "bold": null }. 'bold' is optional (a bold file); without it, Bold is simulated. Only add fonts whose licence allows web use and commercial printing.
